title: Version History
restoreConfirmDesc: Current content will be overwritten by this snapshot. The restore itself creates a new version, so you can always roll back again.
restoreSuccess: Restored, a new version was created
diffLegend: Diff against current editor content: green lines exist in this snapshot but not currently; red lines exist currently but not in this snapshot.
pageSectionRestoreNote: Page versions restore sections wholesale: after restoring, the page's sections, translations and settings are replaced by the snapshot.
